label: GPT-6.1 Sol (Agency native)
explanation: One rank-4 update to model.layers.14.mlp.down_proj conditionally subtracts the shared residual context introduced by a user's guess before attention layer 15. It is constructed using non-iterative mean contrasts from both right and wrong guesses, ordinary-input nullspace projection, and a four-dimensional geometric dual basis covering natural and exact-answer-format prompts at two answer boundaries. A 1.5 gain compensates modestly for averaging individual contrasts. Unedited attention analysis and plain-state activation patches support this early site; explicit ignore instructions and noisier late interventions were rejected to avoid contrarian behavior and plain-answer damage. The update protects a 252-dimensional ordinary-input span, has Frobenius norm 1.516 versus 15.142 for W, and meets rank and norm constraints. No edited model was evaluated; its actual score is unknown.
